segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I pulled up the account in the CRM. Last we talked you were looking at 42 seats for the operations team, with a target go-live of March 18. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. It may be 44 if we include the two regional managers, but procurement asked me to price it both ways.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. So at 42 seats, annual comes to $31,080 before tax. At 44, it's $32,560. The implementation fee stays flat at $4,500 either way.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation, that's the two admin trainings and the data import, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Two 90-minute admin sessions, one end-user training, and import of the last 18 months of service records. If you want us to bring over older closed tickets, that would be a separate estimate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, 18 months is fine. The finance team just needs the invoice to show software and services on separate lines.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that through the billing tool. I’ll note that on the order form too, so there’s no mismatch when it routes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Contract term is still 12 months? We don't want auto-renewal longer than that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It's a 12-month initial term, then it renews for 12-month periods unless either side gives 30 days' notice. That's the standard language on the paper I sent Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. If I send approval today, can we still start kickoff on February 26?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I checked with services this morning, and they have a slot at 10 a.m. Central on the 26th. We'd need the signed order and billing contact by Friday, February 16, to hold it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, I'll push that internally. Send me the revised quote with 44 seats and the separate invoice note, and I'll attach it to the request.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it in the next hour, and I'll include the 42-seat version as an alternate in case procurement asks.
